description: Split a subsystem in two: move some of its own components and child subsystems into a new subsystem beside it (same parent, signal flow and collapsed state; not an enclosure). Use it when a collapsed block has too many ports to fit a sheet. Wires and cables don't change; the ones between the two halves run between two blocks. Name what moves with components (tags) and/or subsystems (names or ids), all directly inside the subsystem, or pass half: true to move about half, keeping blocks wired to each other together. At least one member must stay.

components.description: Tags of components directly in the subsystem to move

half.description: true = pick about half automatically, by wiring; don't combine with components / subsystems

subsystem.description: Name or id of the subsystem to split

subsystems.description: Names or ids of child subsystems to move (with everything in them)

name: split_subsystem
title: Split subsystem
